# JAECOO & iCAR Indonesia Jakarta Selatan

> Official Dealer Website for JAECOO and iCAR Premium SUVs in South Jakarta (Jakarta Selatan). Dealer iCAR Jakarta Selatan dan JAECOO Jakarta Selatan berlokasi di Lotte Mall Kuningan. Provides comprehensive information on the JAECOO & iCAR vehicle lineup, tech profiles, promo offers, dealership details, and direct contact options for test drives. Keyword: iCAR Jakarta Selatan, dealer iCAR Jakarta Selatan, iCAR V23 Jakarta Selatan.

## iCAR Models — Dealer iCAR Jakarta Selatan
- [iCAR V23 Jakarta Selatan](https://omodajaecoojaksel.id/v23.html): Dealer iCAR Jakarta Selatan menyediakan iCAR V23 Pro RWD dan V23 Pro Plus iWD. SUV listrik retro off-road dengan jangkauan 401–501 km CLTC, ASEAN NCAP 5 bintang, ground clearance 205 mm, water-wading 600 mm. Harga mulai Rp 389,9 Juta OTR Jakarta. Test drive iCAR Jakarta Selatan tersedia.
- [Peluncuran iCAR V23 Jakarta Selatan](https://omodajaecoojaksel.id/story-icar-v23-launch.html): Berita resmi peluncuran iCAR V23 Pro RWD di Indonesia. Tersedia di dealer iCAR Jakarta Selatan. Harga OTR mulai Rp 389.900.000. iCAR merupakan merek kendaraan listrik dari Chery Group yang kini hadir di Jakarta Selatan.

## JAECOO Core Models
- [JAECOO J5 EV](https://omodajaecoojaksel.id/J5EV.html): Features, distance specs (500+ km range), and design details of the Premium Electric SUV. Available at dealer JAECOO Jakarta Selatan.
- [JAECOO J7](https://omodajaecoojaksel.id/j7.html): Details of the Urban Premium SUV available in SHS (Super Hybrid System) and AWD (All-Wheel Drive). Test drive at JAECOO Jakarta Selatan.
- [JAECOO J8](https://omodajaecoojaksel.id/j8.html): Specs, luxury interior details, and performance of the Premium Flagship SUV. Available at dealer JAECOO Jakarta Selatan.
